selection_rule: Largest outer oracle-effect L1 increase; largest verb oracle-KL increase; smallest sum of absolute outer/inner edit and verb KL changes. Deduplicate modes. Selection uses development panel only.
caveat: Ablating one score-table token mode across all lags is a functional intervention, not a native model weight edit. Single-mode effects can miss redundant groups. The basis was fitted to unlabeled synthetic data; mode selection used a separate development panel and holdout evaluation was not used to choose the modes.
